entries.title: Dredge worker exceeds container memory
entries.root_cause: The shoal compaction container is OOM-killed while buffering records under a 512 MiB memory limit. Reduce the worker's peak memory usage or increase its limit.

entries.title: Dredge worker exceeds container memory again
entries.root_cause: The shoal compaction container is OOM-killed while buffering records under a 512 MiB memory limit. Reduce the worker's peak memory usage or increase its limit.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A different input and runner encounter the same memory limit, with different timing and build output.

entries.title: Tide window boundary assertion fails
entries.root_cause: The tide window function excludes an event at its inclusive end boundary. Correct the boundary comparison.

entries.title: Archive manifest path is missing
entries.root_cause: The workflow asks the archive upload step for a manifest in a directory that the build does not create. Point the step at the generated manifest path.
